The '''Thesme sector''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. While some [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] threatened to secede during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] ultimately remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under its [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Silya Shessaun/Legends|Silya Shessaun]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a new senator was appointed, followed by a sector [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. The new appointee was corrupt and allowed criminal activities to flourish in parts of the sector. In the midst of this corruption, members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] were able to use some of the Thesme sector's worlds to transfer supplies to their neighboring base in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was one of hundreds assimilated into [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]].

==History==
The Thesme sector was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Another hyperlane, the [[Thesme Trace]], intercepted the Way in the [[Feriae system]], creating a trading hub. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included the planets [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]]<ref name="The Hunt" /> and [[Thesme]].<ref name="Silya Shessaun" />

[[File:Silya-crop.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Silya Shessaun, senator for Thesme sector.]]

Thesme was an industrial world, and the capital of the Thesme sector. During the latter days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the sector's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senatorial]] representative, [[Silya Shessaun/Legends|Silya Shessaun]], was a native of the planet. A staunch [[Loyalist/Legends|loyalist]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she mediated a number of disputes in her sector involving worlds that threatened to secede to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, Shessaun was later made to step down from office by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who replaced her with a more pro-Imperial [[Senator/Legends|senator]]; despite her resolute support of the Republic, her friendship with senators in the [[Delegation of 2000]], such as [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], had cast a shadow over her future allegiance to the Empire.<ref name="Silya Shessaun" /> Later, as the internal structure of the Empire changed, an Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] was appointed to the sector. However, the governor was known to be corrupt and open to bribes, creating room for criminal activity to flourish in some parts of the Thesme sector. [[Slavery/Legends|Slavers]] were allowed to prey on a number of the sector's backwater worlds without fear of too much Imperial interference.<ref name="The Hunt" /> One such group was the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]], which had links on Feriae Junction.<ref name="Zygerrian" />

Feriae Junction was a trade world that boomed during the [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gem]] rush in the nearby [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. However, when the rush passed, the planet's fortunes turned and it became a haven for less reputable sorts. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the principle transfer point for supplies heading to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="The Hunt" />

The Thesme sector was later incorporated into the [[Bright Jewel Oversector/Legends|Bright Jewel Oversector]], along with hundreds of other [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and Outer Rim sectors, by the Galactic Empire. This Oversector was governed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Nox Vellam]].<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' states that hundreds of sectors were assimilated into the Oversector. As Junction was assimilated, it is presumed the entire sector was also.</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Members of the [[B'trillan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were a common sight on the worlds of the Thesme sector.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thesme sector was first named in ''[[The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale]]'' by [[Jason Fry]]. However, the name "Thesme" first appeared in ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'', also by Fry, in reference to the [[Thesme Trace]].

While originally being located withing the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]],<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> the [[Ferrous Aurora Nebula/Legends|Ferrous Aurora Nebula]] was placed in the Thesme sector by the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', later acknowledged that the placement in the Online Companion was erroneous.<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion_2025.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-09-17}}</ref>
